component.text: <textformat blockindent='-14'>Standard ACLs filter IP packets based on the source address only.</textformat>

Extended ACLs filter IP packets based on several attributes, including the following:
  • Alamat IP sumber dan tujuan
  • Port TCP dan UDP sumber dan tujuan
  • Jenis protokol/Nomor protokol (contoh: IP, ICMP, UDP, TCP, dll.)
